name: Bow of Nylea

abilities.text: Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch.

notes: The four bullets belong to the 'Choose one -' line and are the four modes of the choose-mode effect.

issues: Bow of Nylea deals 2 damage to target creature with flying — expected the damaged creature dies to 2 damage — scripted damage 2 with target {kind:'creature', filter:{flying:true}} — the filter key IS supported (characteristics.ts:250) and legal.ts builds the spec, so the blind failure (Wind Drake survived, no 'deals 2 damage' in the log) reads as the harness mode-selection gap, not a wrong effect. Could not fully rule out a mode-dispatch defect

Put up to four target cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library in any order — expected 'in any order' — you choose the relative order of the cards placed on the bottom — scripted move with pos:'bottom' — order is whatever the move loop iterates; the ordering choice is not modelled. Targeting and the 'up to four' are correct (graveyard-card TargetSpec with count:4, optional:true) — CR CR 701.x / 400.7 — the player choosing the order is a real choice

• Put up to four target cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library in any order. — expected up to four TARGET cards, chosen on activation — scripted move what:{kind:'graveyard-card', who:'you', count:4, optional:true} — a resolution-time chooser, not targets. The scenario supplies targets:[['Lightning Bolt','Shock']] which the chooser path never consumes; both cards stayed in the graveyard — CR 115.1, 601.2c

Blind-result claim: 'Both are the harness mode-selection gap, not a wrong effect' — expected claim should be substantiated — scripted UNSUPPORTED. Mode 0 ({"answer":[0]}) and mode 2 ({"answer":[2]}, gain 3 life) both PASS, so mode selection demonstrably works; if it always defaulted to mode 0 the life-gain scenario would have failed. Modes 1 and 3 fail for their own reasons — mode 3 is the targeting mismatch above, mode 1 ('deals 2 damage to target creature with flying', target {kind:'creature', filter:{flying:true}}) produced no damage log at all against Wind Drake — CR 700.2

Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch. — expected static grant to attacking creatures you control — scripted anthem 0/0 with filter {attacking:true}, scope you-control, keywords ['deathtouch'] — correct; matchesFilter honours f.attacking (characteristics.ts:248) and both deathtouch scenarios pass — CR 702.2b
